regime_context: Detector shows a broad, uncrowded Gold Miners leadership with high durability (0.82) and full breadth, sitting ~0.37 score-points ahead of Silver & Royalties — a cohesive precious-metals cluster atop a market where the absolute-trend gate has demonstrably helped drawdown control. Momentum rank is a focus lens only, and the 54-call track record (dir_accuracy 0.278) demands low conviction on any directional lean.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Base Metals & Copper leadership attempts a handoff from the precious-metals cluster — currently crowded (z 1.11) but eligible with decent durability (0.76). The observable condition to retire this watch: Base Metals & Copper posts two consecutive weeks of higher score than Silver & Royalties while its breadth stays at 1.0.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is the only theme combining a durable trend tag, full breadth (1.0), the highest rank-adjacent score, and no crowding — the staying-power leg is genuinely alive here. This is a trend-health read, not a return forecast: the absolute-trend gate has historically cut drawdown in this market, and Gold Miners is one of the few names currently passing it cleanly with non-mixed Hurst behavior.
evidence: eligible true and top rank among scorable ETFs (XGD.TO)
theses.dissent: Commodity-miner momentum is reflexive and mean-reverting at tops; gold's run may already be priced, and the track record shows directional calls land barely better than coin-flip on direction.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX composite by 6% or more within 20 trading days

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Challenger in the same precious-metals cluster with durable-enough trend health (0.76) and full breadth — a cohesive secondary leg that confirms the metals narrative rather than competing with it. Leaning with the cluster, not against the leader.
evidence: margin to leader only 0.371 — tight, confirming cluster cohesion
theses.dissent: Silver beta to gold can exaggerate drawdowns when the whole metals complex stalls; the 'mixed' Hurst tag means the trend is not as clean as the leader's.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO (silver/royalty proxy share class) lags XGD.TO Gold Miners by 4% or more within 15 trading days

theses.subject: Pipelines & Midstream
theses.thesis: Unscorable (no proxy) and mid-pack by score (0.248) with only 0.556 breadth and a mixed Hurst tag — the trend-health leg does not support a lean, and the detector's only validated edge (trend gate) offers no clean read here. Avoid is a de-risk stance, not a fade.
evidence: score 0.248 — positive but far from leadership
theses.dissent: Midstream cash-flow stability could outperform in a risk-off backdrop regardless of momentum rank.
